description: Phase 2a capability set for the main window (architecture.md §16.3): only the safe core defaults (window/app/event/resource basics, which already include event listen/emit - core:default composes core:event:default) plus the three plugin permissions the IPC command surface genuinely needs. The dialog and opener plugins are called only from Rust command handlers (select_input_files/select_input_directory/select_output_directory, reveal_path, open_path) - never invoked directly by the frontend - and every reveal_path/open_path call is additionally allowlist-checked in Rust against job history/artifacts before the plugin is called (application::paths::resolve_allowed_path). No shell execution, no arbitrary command spawning, and no broad filesystem access are granted; the sidecar is invoked only via the engine module's own verified-path resolver, which the webview cannot name or reach.
